column6: Official homepage lists Women in Business Inspired Workshop on Aug 12, 2026 and Leadership Lunch on Aug 18 as upcoming events.
Official site has registration open for the June 24-26 2026 camp at nCino HQ in Lehi.
Utah Veterans Affairs lists a Sept 25 2026 veteran-entrepreneur networking event hosted by the Kaysville SBDC at Davis Tech, the BRC onsite partner the wiki page scopes.
Deseret News Aug 12 2026 reports a federal settlement keeping Clearfield Job Corps open and continually accepting applications after 2025 closure notices.
ETV News reports the chamber held its May 21 2026 monthly luncheon at USU Eastern featuring 2026 local candidates.
County ED official form posts the Rural County Grant 2027-funding cycle open July 1 2026 with a December 1 2026 application deadline.
SEEN news page dated 5/7/25 reports Mama D Food Shop operating curb pickup from the BTAC building on Carbon Avenue; ELF application page is undated.
Dishing Park City Sept 18 2025 visit piece lists current tenant businesses and daily 8am-5pm marketplace hours at 370 S 300 E.
St. George News reports the chamber hosted its 76th Best of Cedar City awards gala on March 5 2026 at SUU; chamber calendar pages fetched with no dated listings.
USHE November 2025 Custom Fit annual report covers FY2025 (year ending June 30 2025): 451161 training hours to 16673 employees at 1847 companies.
PR Newswire Feb 26 2026: Cynosure acquired Utah Development and Construction for a Clyde Capital joint venture; firm also posted Jan 2026 promotions.
Utah Tech Calendar lists CTO Breakfast Utah at IHOP American Fork on Friday Aug 14 2026 and subsequent second-Friday dates; official chapter page has cadence only.
Utah Business July 29 2025 reports Crew closed a $3M seed round with Convoi Ventures as a participating investor; Convoi homepage itself is undated with a 2022 footer.
Official Women in Business page lists an Aug 13 2026 roundtable at Texas Roadhouse Layton plus a priced Aug 20 2026 chamber luncheon registration.
Databento July 9 2026 Series B post lists Cross Creek among investors in a $97M round; Cross Creek own news page had no dated stories.
Official Utah Business Forward page schedules the conference for Nov 10 2026 at Salt Lake Marriott with early-bird tickets June 16-Aug 31 2026.
Official BRC page is undated present-tense copy; Launch Series lists an April cohort as CANCELLED with no year; July 2026 Utah Tech economic-impact PDF still cites BRC consultation counts as of 2023.
Fetched the Offices.net SLC coworking directory (13 undated listings); no listing-update date, fee schedule date, or other current-cycle artifact; a live aggregator page is not a signal.
Davis County Commission June 23 2026 agenda includes a CED public hearing on Series 2026 Kihomac industrial development revenue bonds; loan-fund page still says application coming soon.
Chamber site set a March 1 2026 deadline for Snow Goose Festival photography entries; homepage also lists Snow Goose Festival 2026.
EDCUtah May 14 2026 news post on supporting Trigg Minerals $287M Garfield/Iron project; related April 2026 posts cover Karman and Creekstone.
Emery County Economic Opportunity Board Feb 10 2026 minutes allocate Rural County Grant funds after 27 business-improvement applications and set a 2026 meeting calendar.
BioUtah Aug 28 2025 reports Epic Ventures received $200M in fresh capital; firm homepage fetch returned almost no dated content (probe newest year 2020).
Listed URL escalantecity-utah.com returns 500; live city page at escalanteutah.gov posts undated $25/$100/$300 rates; USU Extension still says coming soon; May 2025 council-minutes PDF 500d.
Moab Sun News reports the Grand Business Summit ran Jan 16 2026 at SpringHill Suites; official grandsummitmoab.com is still frozen on Aug 20 2024 registration.
